display_name: Meerut Trooper of the 3rd Bengal Cavalry
one_line: A Purbiya cavalryman of the Bengal Army among the 85 Meerut troopers punished in May 1857 who became a symbol of honor, humiliation and revolt.

appearance.age_look: mid-20s, lean but strong cavalry build
appearance.face: oval face with sharp jawline, medium-brown North Indian complexion, straight nose, calm intense eyes with slightly furrowed brows, a neatly trimmed short moustache, default expression resolute with contained anger and dignity
appearance.hair: black hair pulled into a short, tidy knot at the back, mostly concealed under a deep red pagri-style turban with neat layers and a small dark brass regimental badge at the front-left
appearance.costume: mid-19th-century Bengal cavalry uniform: a fitted dark navy-blue kurta-style tunic reaching mid-thigh with stand collar and brass buttons, worn over cream cotton churidar trousers; a wide brown leather cross-belt over the right shoulder with cartridge pouch and small buckle, matching brown leather waist belt with simple rectangular brass buckle; dark brown leather riding boots just below the knee; a deep red sash tied at the waist with one end hanging to the left, and a plain off-white cotton angarkha-style overcoat draped open from the shoulders in some scenes to evoke marching and court-martial humiliation, all fabrics matte and slightly worn, appropriate to campaign use.
appearance.signature: A Pattern 1853 Enfield rifle held in the left hand with sling over the shoulder, and an era-authentic light cavalry talwar with a simple iron hilt sheathed at his left hip, the rifle quietly symbolizing the cartridge crisis and the sword his caste honor.

ref_desc: A lean, mid-1850s Purbiya cavalryman with navy-blue tunic, cream churidar, deep red turban and waist sash, brown leather belts and boots, brass details, carrying a Pattern 1853 Enfield rifle and sheathed talwar, in a resolute, dignified anime style.
sheet_prompt: Draw a full-body anime-style character sheet of a mid-19th-century Purbiya cavalry trooper from the Bengal Army: lean, mid-20s, medium-brown complexion, oval face with sharp jaw, calm intense eyes and a short neat moustache, expression resolute and dignified. His black hair is tied in a short knot, covered by a deep red pagri-style turban with neat folds and a small dark brass badge on the front-left. He wears a fitted dark navy-blue kurta-style tunic with stand collar and brass buttons over cream churidar trousers, a deep red sash at the waist with one end hanging to the left, and dark brown leather riding boots below the knee. A wide brown leather cross-belt with cartridge pouch runs over his right shoulder, matched by a brown leather waist belt with a simple rectangular brass buckle. At his left hip hangs a sheathed talwar with a plain iron hilt, while a Pattern 1853 Enfield rifle with sling rests over his shoulder or in his left hand, both rendered with historically accurate proportions and simple utilitarian detailing. Fabrics are matte and slightly worn, leather shows creases, brass adds small highlights. Show him front, three-quarter and back views in one image, clearly presenting hair, turban, face, tunic, sash, trousers, boots, belts, rifle and sword in consistent navy blue, cream, deep red, brown leather and brass tones, emphasizing a grounded historical yet shonen-anime heroic look.
